About this item

  • Touch Control 3 Color Stepless Dimmable - Tap the button at the top of the LED touch lamp to turn on/off and switch the color temperature (3000K warm white, 5000K daylight white, 4000K natural white). Long press the touch button to adjust the brightness for each color mode from 5% to 100% (with brightness memory function).
  • Large Capacity Rechargeable Battery - Built-in 5000mAh rechargeable battery, charge with USB-C, fully charged in 6 hours after fully discharged. Battery runtime 8-40 hours depending on the brightness used. Battery Cycle life 500 to 1000 times, about 3-5 years. The battery lamp can be used as an emergency light in case of power outage.
  • Wide Range of Scenarios - There are no cables and no need to be constantly connected to the power supply. The cordless rechargeable table lamps allow you to place it in any space of home. It can also be assembled into two heights of lamps (14.7in and 9.3in) according to your needs. This rechargeable lamp is suitable for dining table, kitchen, living room, bedroom to create a romantic atmosphere.
  • Portable Cordless Lamp - The surface of the outdoor table lamp is fully covered with high-quality coating, which is anti-scratch and anti-corrosion, allowing the cordless desk lamp to be used outdoors. And with its lightweight and portable feature, it is suitable for patio, camping, picnic and bathroom, creating a soft and warm atmosphere for you.
  • We Promise - Key electronic components are UL listed. In addition, to make sure you get the best shopping experience, we will provide free replacement service within 6 months. If your lamp set has any defects or stops working during this period, we will help you troubleshoot or send you a new product.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    Customers say

    Customers find these table lamps attractive and versatile, suitable for both indoor and outdoor patio settings, with three levels of light from warm to bright and adjustable in both brightness and warmth. They are easy to assemble and use, and can be charged via USB cord. The battery life and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say the charge lasts a good while and the lamps last a long time on full brightness, others report the lamps won't last a night and only last a couple of days non-stop.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Great little lamps especially if your outlets are in weird places
    These are great little lamps I have one in my bedroom and one in my guest bedroom (pictured). They come with small charging cables that are USB to USB-C I just use the USB-C charger I used to charge my phone to charge them. I’m not exactly sure how long it took to charge them because I left them plugged in and left the house to go grocery shopping when he came back the light was green so I unplugged them. They have multiple settings for brightness. I like the cordless some of the outlets in my house are not in the best areas for bedside tables etc. I also like that I could use these during a power outages since I live in Florida. Aesthetically I think these are cute and pleasing. I got them discounted they were on sale I think they were a great deal for $12 but even at the normal price of $20 I think they still are worth it.

      I've gotten a couple of pairs of these touch lamps for use on gaming tables. My gaming guests often see these and are impressed enough to get some for themselves. There are a number of reasons why: The shade ensures it only lights the table without getting in the eyes. And they do charge quick in case you forgot you're having company that evening. The lighting levels are convenient, depending on the ambient light, user need, or color of the gaming materials.     About this Item

    • Touch Control 3 Color Stepless Dimmable - Tap the button at the top of the LED touch lamp to turn on/off and switch the color temperature (3000K warm white, 5000K daylight white, 4000K natural white). Long press the touch button to adjust the brightness for each color mode from 5% to 100% (with brightness memory function).
    • Large Capacity Rechargeable Battery - Built-in 5000mAh rechargeable battery, charge with USB-C, fully charged in 6 hours after fully discharged. Battery runtime 8-40 hours depending on the brightness used. Battery Cycle life 500 to 1000 times, about 3-5 years. The battery lamp can be used as an emergency light in case of power outage.
    • Wide Range of Scenarios - There are no cables and no need to be constantly connected to the power supply. The cordless rechargeable table lamps allow you to place it in any space of home. It can also be assembled into two heights of lamps (14.7in and 9.3in) according to your needs. This rechargeable lamp is suitable for dining table, kitchen, living room, bedroom to create a romantic atmosphere.
    • Portable Cordless Lamp - The surface of the outdoor table lamp is fully covered with high-quality coating, which is anti-scratch and anti-corrosion, allowing the cordless desk lamp to be used outdoors. And with its lightweight and portable feature, it is suitable for patio, camping, picnic and bathroom, creating a soft and warm atmosphere for you.
    • We Promise - Key electronic components are UL listed. In addition, to make sure you get the best shopping experience, we will provide free replacement service within 6 months. If your lamp set has any defects or stops working during this period, we will help you troubleshoot or send you a new product.
